tool.name: Publish LinkedIn Post
tool.description: Publish LinkedIn posts as member or organization. Supports text-only and single-image (imageUrls[] or attachmentIds[]). Media uploads are registered under the same URN as the post author (LinkedIn requires content ownership). dryRun=true returns a plan without API calls.

imageUrls.description: Optional array of HTTPS image URLs. Currently only the first image is used.

attachmentIds.description: Optional array of Starships attachment IDs. Currently only the first attachment is used.

imageDescription.description: Optional alt text for the image (accessibility).
